items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. That's where Peggy Lee is from. In Jamestown.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's where Peggy Lee is from. In Jamestown. So he told me, he says, "I got this horn and I can't play it." He had a gold... Not no gold like they do now. They made gold horns in them days. Burnished gold. And he said it was a Martin. He says, "If you pick up the paint(?) that's on it, you can have it." A horn like that then cost something like about 250 dollars. In them days, that was aa lot of money. He said, "You let me have the Buesher, and I'll owe five more payments on it, but I'm going to lose it…
But anyway, getting back to the horn, he gave me that horn. In fact, about most everybody in there had Bueshers, all but the saxophones. The C-melodys, they were Conns.
